title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Billing Calculation Note: Late Charge on the Most Recent Rental Invoice Month
content:
# Billing Calculation Note — Late Charge on the Most Recent Rental Invoice Month, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Definitions

(a) **Most recent rental invoice.** The unit's rental invoice with the latest invoice date; where two share that date, the one posted first is used. Its invoice month is the billing period printed on it.

(b) **Business payments applied to an invoice month.** The payments the unit's ledger records against that month, each payment being recorded against the month it was applied to when it posted; a payment recorded against no invoice month is not counted.

## Calculation

The late-charge base is the most recent rental invoice amount less the business payments applied to that invoice month, never below zero. The late-charge rate is the late-charge percentage of the unit's program tier, and the late-charge minimum is the late-charge minimum of that tier. The late charge is the late-charge base multiplied by the late-charge rate and divided by 100, but never less than the late-charge minimum, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Order of figuring.** A schedule that replaces a standard figure applies first; any multiplier then applies to the charge after the minimum; any addition comes last; and the charge is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, tier late-charge percentage 1.5 and minimum 25)

| | Example A | Example B |
|---|---|---|
| Most recent rental invoice amount | 2213.00 | 1400.00 |
| Payments recorded against that month | 413.00 | 200.00 |
| Late-charge base | 1800.00 | 1200.00 |
| Base multiplied by 1.5, divided by 100 | 27.00 | 18.00 |
| Compared with the minimum of 25 | above | below |
| Late charge | 27.00 | 25.00 |

## Points of judgement

- **Two invoices dated the same latest day?** The one posted first is the most recent rental invoice.
- **A payment posted without an invoice month?** It is not counted against any month.
- **Payments exceeding the invoice?** The base is never below zero; the charge is then the minimum.
